mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a quarter signals a supply shock, leading to reduced corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO drops by more than 2% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within a month signals a strengthening demand for housing, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within a month signals deflationary pressure, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) both increase by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both UNRATE and PAYEMS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) both show a decline of more than 1% within a quarter, it signals a broad-based weakening of demand, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS declined by more than 1% within a quarter.
